title: Occupancy Certificate vs Completion Certificate: Why They Matter and How to Check Them
seoTitle: Occupancy Certificate vs Completion Certificate: OC vs CC
seoDescription: Occupancy certificate vs completion certificate: what OC and CC mean under RERA, partial OC, how to verify them, and what to do if possession has no OC.
excerpt: A buyer's guide to OC and CC under the RERA Act: the key sections, Supreme Court rulings, partial OC, how Delhi, Karnataka and Maharashtra differ, and a step-by-step verification checklist.
